name: Sampler
description: One-sound sampler for your own recordings: the keys transpose it, a crossfaded loop holds it as long as you like, and a little tape wobble makes it a pad.

params.name: Start
params.description: The front edge of the region the keys play and loop. A later start skips the attack of the recording.

params.name: End
params.description: The back edge of the region the keys play and loop. An earlier end leaves out the tail of the recording.

params.name: Loop
params.description: Off plays the region once and stops. Forward repeats it from the start, and Ping-pong plays it there and back.

params.name: Crossfade
params.description: Smooths the jump of a Forward loop by blending the end of each pass into the next. Longer hides a rougher loop.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: On plays the region backwards, so each key starts from the End.

params.name: Tune
params.description: Transposes the whole instrument. Pitch and speed move together, so lower also plays the recording slower.

params.name: Fine
params.description: A small pitch offset on top of Tune, for matching the recording to other instruments.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a note takes to fade in. Short keeps the recording's own start; long turns it into a swell.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade out after the key is let go.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Low-pass filter on the whole instrument. Lower settings take the top off for a darker, softer sound.

params.name: Wobble
params.description: Tape-style pitch wobble shared by all keys: a slow wow with some drift and a trace of flutter. Zero is steady.

params.name: Velocity
params.description: How much playing harder makes a note louder. At zero every note plays at full level.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. Pushed hard, a soft clipper rounds off the peaks.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A Mellotron in spirit only: one recording per instance, transposed by the key, with a loop the tape machines never had.
